reason: As a fixed-income homeowner who voted no last time, I'd be most moved by A's offer to work out my own bill ($19 a year per $100,000 of assessed value) and its direct answer to former no voters: the Ridgeview branch closes in July without the levy. A also answers 'blank check' with the $2.3 million and the two things it pays for. B is honest too, and its admission that '$10 a month is nothing' isn't true is respectful, but it gives me less reason to change my vote.
